newsitem.title: USA: Infosafe to remain listed on Nasdaq.
newsitem.headline: Infosafe to remain listed on Nasdaq.

text.p: Infosafe Systems Inc said on Friday that it will remain listed on the Nasdaq SmallCap market pending a review by Nasdaq's board.
Infosafe had received a notice that it was going to be delisted for failing to meet the net assets standard for the market, the company said.

A tentative deal with an investment banker for a private placement of up to $5 million of common stock and warrants and an initial closing on $1 million of the offering with in one week will satisfy the listing standard, the company said.
Infosafe said it is optimistic that the offering will be completed and it will be successful in its appeal of Nasdaq's decision.
